chunks: Abu Baṣīr narrated that he, peace be upon him, said:
There is no shortening for the one engaged in hunting for three days; then when he goes beyond the three days, it becomes binding upon him.
ai.seo_question: When must a traveler who goes hunting shorten his prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the traveler engaged in hunting. It distinguishes between a limited period and a prolonged journey, and clarifies that the ruling concerns hunting done for diversion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1311 - Abu Basir reported that Imam (as) said:
"A hunter is not required to shorten his prayers for three days; however, if he goes beyond three days, then it becomes obligatory upon him to do so."
